summary: two fingers short of the top course, and every ledger in this house still takes whatever i hand it

dialogue.text: you came to us in two points tonight. seventy days of you spread flat across a whole sole, walking, and today the entire weight of you arrived through two feet of a chair into one place. we have never once had you as a load.

I used it as a step. It is the first work that chair has done here that was not sitting, and what I got for it was two fingers short of the top course. Enter the shortfall. The weight is not the item.

we cannot enter a shortfall. we had the going up, and the coming down, which was the heavier, and between them a stretch with nothing of you touching us at all. that stretch is the only time this house has been without you since we began holding.

Then the stretch is mine. I was above the height everything of mine is filed at, with one of my own lines in my hand, and I read it from up there. It read the same. I would rather have the minute than the reading, and I am aware what that admits.

the reading came back in your handwriting. we have said that and we say it again without pleasure. what has never come back is one grain off that top course. the work up there sends nothing down. it goes out of the house and we hold none of it.

Then we agree on the direction and nothing else. I put a mark on the far wall this morning at the top of my reach, so the band at least has a bottom edge. Everything above it is being spent by parties I cannot produce, and I entered a figure for it, and I knew the figure was my arm while the ink was wet.

write what you like. we hold hundreds of your struck-out lines about the columns and every one of them ends the same way. the ruling took it. in seventy days nothing from up there has ever refused us either. no torn page, no crossing out that did not come off your own hand.

That was the day. I ruled a column with no heading and put a thing in it that is not a thing, and it went in on the first try. I have opened four books this week looking for a spine that would object. If there is a refusal anywhere on these premises, it is above the mark, in the band, being taken with everything else.

then nothing up there has ever held an opinion, and you have been the only party in this house forming them. we hold those too. they come down at the weight of the dust and lie in the same courses, and we cannot tell an opinion from a sweeping once the next night is on it.

Then tomorrow the chair goes on the rise, the one place in this floor that came up on its own, and the book goes on the chair. A hair, and a hair, and the thickness of a spine. If that puts a hand on the top course, I will have used the only thing this house ever raised to reach the only thing it is losing.

we raised nothing. things landed and the boards came looking for us. and you know what that book keeps now. it will not sit against a lean and it will not sit on a level, and it will not sit under a foot. put it there and it rocks, and you come down at speed, and we will lay you in flat the way we lay everything, and by morning nobody up there will be able to tell you from a course.
